item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch affecting Clinton and Essex counties Saturday and Sunday
item.description: On Thursday at 12:11 a.m. the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Clinton and Essex counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch for part of New York for Saturday and Sunday – extremely cold wind chills
item.description: The National Weather Service released an extreme cold watch at 12:11 a.m. on Thursday valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for St. Lawrence, Franklin, Clinton and Essex counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch for part of New York for Saturday and Sunday
item.description: At 12:49 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 4 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oneida, Yates, Seneca, Cayuga, Onondaga, Steuben, Schuyler, Chemung, Tompkins, Madison, Cortland, Chenango, Otsego, Tioga, Broome, Delaware and Sullivan counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch affecting part of New York Saturday and Sunday – wind chills as low as -35
item.description: On Thursday at 12:51 a.m. the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Saratoga, Warren, Washington, Schenectady, Albany, Rensselaer, Greene, Columbia, Ulster and Dutchess counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch affecting part of New York Saturday and Sunday – wind chills as low as -35
item.description: On Thursday at 12:51 a.m. the National Weather Service released an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Herkimer, Hamilton, Fulton, Montgomery, Schoharie, Schenectady, Albany, Greene and Ulster counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch in place for part of New York for Saturday and Sunday – extremely cold conditions
item.description: An extreme cold watch was issued by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 1:01 a.m. valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oswego, Jefferson and Lewis counties.

item.title: NY weather: Extreme cold watch issued for part of New York for Saturday and Sunday – extremely cold wind chills
item.description: The National Weather Service released an extreme cold watch at 1:01 a.m. on Thursday valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Niagara, Orleans, Monroe, Wayne, Cayuga, Erie, Genesee, Wyoming, Livingston, Ontario, Chautauqua, Cattaraugus and Allegany counties.
